title: Conjectura registry of mathematical contributions
description: One record per contribution. Only identification, statement, provenance, evidence and status are required; everything else is added as the contribution matures. The four status dimensions, the novelty-search record and the resolution source are the definitions of the catalogue schema, not copies of them.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 of a statement, as printed by `python scripts/catalogue.py fingerprint <id>`.

id.description: Permanent identifier. Never reused, never renumbered, independent of the type.

type.description: Kind of contribution. May be corrected without changing the identifier.

statement.description: The exact claim of this record, self-contained, with all hypotheses and quantifiers. The status describes this statement and nothing else.

who.description: A person's name or an exact model identifier.

role.description: What this contributor did, in the categories of docs/attribution-policy.md.

record.description: Repository path of the journal entry or notes that document how the contribution arose.

evidence.description: References to existing files. Contents are never copied into the registry.

revision.description: Git commit at which the evidence was produced or, for a review, the commit reviewed.

sha256.description: Optional pin of the file (line endings normalised to LF). Validation fails when the file changes.

statement_fingerprint.description: For a review: the fingerprint of the statement it covers, set after comparing this record's statement with what was reviewed.

by.description: For a review: the reviewer (person or exact model identifier).

depends_on.description: Mathematical proof dependencies only: results that the argument for this statement uses.

citation.description: An external result, cited to its source.

statement_fingerprint.description: The statement of `ref` that this record was checked against.

relations.description: Contextual and logical relationships. None of them is a proof dependency.

local_id.description: Identifier of this contribution inside the target investigation (for example L1).

manuscript.description: Manuscript that presents this contribution. Several records may name the same one.
